question.text: The Manager of an AIF shall not provide advisory services to any investor for investment in securities of investee companies, except through:

answer.text: Clients of a Co-investment Portfolio Manager as specified under the SEBI (Portfolio Managers) Regulations, 2020

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook, the Manager of an AIF shall not provide advisory services to investors other than clients of a Co-investment Portfolio Manager registered under the SEBI (Portfolio Managers) Regulations, 2020. This is the source-stated advisory-services exception. The Trap: Co-investment schemes are addressed by the workbook as a separate co-investment route, but they are not framed by the workbook as the advisory-services exception itself. Note: This restriction operates alongside the AIF's broader conflict-of-interest and code-of-conduct obligations.
